nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme colors, animations, and typography for the workshop site. Exports a Tailwind Config object with extended colors (dark, cream, purple, pink), custom font family, keyframe animations (float-slow, float-slower, gradient-shift, fade-in-up, glow-pulse, shimmer), and animation shortcuts.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.summary: TypeScript type imported from 'tailwindcss' package for configuration typing

nodes.name: config
nodes.summary: Tailwind configuration object instance with type annotation Config. Contains content array for template files, extended theme with colors, typography, keyframes, and animations.

nodes.name: colors
nodes.summary: Custom color theme extension defining four brand colors: dark (#151515), cream (#FCF4EB), purple (#7C69C7), and pink (#F5C3C6)

nodes.name: fontFamily
nodes.summary: Font family configuration using CSS variable --font-plus-jakarta as primary sans-serif font with system-ui and generic sans-serif fallbacks

nodes.name: keyframes
nodes.summary: Custom keyframe animations: float-slow (Y-axis 22px translation), float-slower (Y-axis 18px translation), gradient-shift (background position), fade-in-up (opacity and Y translation), glow-pulse (box shadow), and shimmer (background position)

nodes.name: animation
nodes.summary: Animation shortcuts binding keyframes to duration, easing, and iteration settings. Includes float-slow (7s), float-slower (9s), gradient-shift (6s), fade-in-up (0.5s), glow-pulse (3s), and shimmer (3s)

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Project documentation for Claude Code agents describing GitNexus code intelligence guidelines, usage rules, and workflows. Contains sections on impact analysis, change detection, code exploration, and refactoring with references to GitNexus skills and resources.

nodes.name: GitNexus Header
nodes.summary: Introduction to GitNexus code intelligence indexing. Declares workshop-site project has 2960 symbols, 4551 relationships, 123 execution flows. References index freshness and analysis command.

nodes.name: Always Do
nodes.summary: Mandatory practices for code editing: run impact analysis on symbols before editing, detect changes before committing, warn on HIGH/CRITICAL risk, use GitNexus query for exploration, use gitnexus_context for symbol details

nodes.name: Never Do
nodes.summary: Prohibited practices: never edit without impact analysis, never ignore risk warnings, never use find-and-replace for renaming, never commit without detecting changes
